# My Broker Name Opt-Out

| Attribute | Details |
|---|---|
| **Method** | Automated Web Form |
| **Opt-Out URL** | https://example.com/opt-out |
| **User Action Required** | Click confirmation link delivered to email |
| **Statutory Response Window** | 45 days (CCPA) / 30 days (GDPR) |
| **Source Citation** | https://example.com/privacy-policy |
| **Last Verified** | Not yet verified live |

## How the Flow Works

1. Navigates to the official broker opt-out form.
2. Fills first name, last name, and an isolated confirmation alias (`contact_email`).
3. Submits the form and verifies the receipt confirmation message.
4. User clicks the verification link emailed to their alias to finalize removal.
